newsitem.title: ITALY: Chinese man found with 150,000 Rome bus tickets.
newsitem.headline: Chinese man found with 150,000 Rome bus tickets.

text.p: A Chinese man carrying 150,000 counterfeit bus tickets valid only for use in Rome, was detained at the city's Fiumicino airport on Tuesday, police said.
They said the tickets, which cost around $1 each when purchased at regular outlets, were found in the luggage of a 26-year-old arriving on a flight from Taiwan.

He was named as Wang Quan Sheng, a Rome resident who had been visiting family in the Chinese province of Fujian. Police said they believed the counterfeit tickets had been printed in either China, Taiwan or Hong Kong.
Wang, who could face a year in jail if convicted of charges of counterfeiting, was released on bail.
